[[Fahralon's Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Fahralon the Zealous]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Domain of Pain]].

==Stats==
<!-- example item and stats, replace as appropriate -->

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ornate Scythe]] dyed white.
